name: Mike Gushansky
bio1: I like analog things. I grew up playing the piano, then collecting records and djing, and shooting film. I enjoy getting lost.
bio2: Music discovery, djing and producing events is what I spend a lot of my time thinking about and doing. I picked up my first turntables in 07 from Turntable Lab on Fairfax and haven't looked back. 20 years of DJing and producing events: underground parties in the Santa Cruz forests, a 6-year residency at AYLI SF, co-founding LA underground series Redline, and playing across Asia, North America, South America, and Europe. Working on a new project, and thrilled to be sharing more here soon.
bio3: Accidentally fell into my first film camera at a flea market in Santa Cruz in 08. $20 later and I was the owner of a heavily used canon rebel. I like to capture real life as it happens, whether its my favorite people, new horizons or the harshness of living on the street. I shoot 35 and 120mm on my F3 and 500cm.  I take my cameras everywhere.
bio4: I love to travel and perform. Message me if you want to get in touch. Hope you enjoy sounds and pixels.
